data.summary: The dbt_spark directory contains configuration files for a dbt project targeting an Apache Spark backend. Together, dbt_project.yml and profiles.yml define the project's structure, materialization defaults, and database connection settings.

file_insights.name: dbt_project.yml
file_insights.summary: Configures project-level settings, paths, hooks, and default materialization strategies for the dbt Spark project.
file_insights.source_summary: Contains YAML configuration defining the project settings, model paths, run-start hooks, and materialization parameters for iceberg, views, and tables.
file_insights.detailed_description: dbt_project.yml serves as the core configuration file for the dbt project named ecommerce_spark, specifying project metadata, model paths, hooks, and materialization defaults. It sets up the default file format as iceberg, configures staging models as views, and marts models as tables.
responsibilities: Configure model paths and target profile
Set up default materialization strategies for staging and marts
Invoke session assertions on run start

file_insights.name: profiles.yml
file_insights.summary: Defines connection profiles and parameters for connecting dbt to a Spark Thrift server.
file_insights.source_summary: Contains YAML connection configurations for the Spark adapter using thrift method with environment variable support for host configuration.
file_insights.detailed_description: profiles.yml defines the connection profiles for dbt to communicate with the Spark Thrift server. It sets up development connection parameters including host, port, user, schema, threads, and retry/timeout behaviors.
responsibilities: Configure Spark Thrift server connection parameters like host and port
Set execution schema and thread count
